ESE 452.attendance: Attendance is needed to earn participation points. Up to two unexcused class absences carry no participation penalty. Excused absences are decided case by case.

ESE 452.makeups: Excused absences or late submissions may be granted without penalty, decided individually. Presentation dates change only for exceptional circumstances or with approval one week ahead.
